title: Voluntary Job Hunting
transcript:
Woman: Jack?Man: Oh hi, Mary! How are you? Enjoying your voluntary job?
Speaker 1: You are working for a large building firm as a volunteer, aren’t you?Woman: Yes, I started after I graduated this June. It’s fantastic.Man: Wow, that’s good to know. I remember you majored in architectural design in college, you must have lots of opportunities to put it into practice.Woman: Well actually I am working as a receptionist right now. I want to improve my interpersonal skills as I need to work with different personalities.Man: I’m sure this will be of great help. But you must be busy all the time, I imagine there are quite a lot of customers all day long as it’s a big company.Woman: Not really, I don’t work full time, usually the work lasts for 4 hours in the morning. Then someone will be on the afternoon shift. Also, I only need to be there on weekdays, so it’s okay.Man: So what exactly do you do? I guess you have to answer the phone, arrange appointments, and deal with people when they have complaints?Woman: Yeah, those can be part of my work, but I mainly respond to the emails from our clients.Man: Have you participated in any training courses yet? I remember last time you once joined a training club as a volunteer.Woman: Yes, of course, I thought I would receive some communication courses from this job, you know, to get some basic interpersonal communication skills. But there are only computer classes available, it’s kind of vocational education.Man: Is that free or do you have to pay for that?Woman: It’s not free, but we’ve got some subsidies from a bank which has gone into partnership with this building company.Man: That’s not bad. I wish I could get some funding from somewhere...our project is so expensive.Woman: I heard that you are working on an Urban River Project, is that right?Man: Yes, my former employer recommended it to me, it’s a big project, the largest irrigation project so far in this city.Woman: Wow, that’s amazing, I never knew you are interested in water conservancy.It must be quite challenging.Man: Yeah, actually I was planning to work in the field related to education, you know, I have always wanted to be a math teacher, but I decided to try something different in my life before I become a teacher.Woman: Of course, you will have some special experience. What does this job require you to do? Things like doing some complicated calculations?Man: Right, and before we go into any of that, we need to attend a workshop beforehand, that involves group discussion in which we share our knowledge and experience together.Woman: Sounds interesting, I bet you can get a lot from those discussions with all the experts there...Man: Sure, I really have learned a lot, it’s quite rewarding.Woman: Oh right, you remember my cousin, Simon?Man: Of course, we took part in an international research project last summer and we cooperated well. He is excellent to work with.Woman: Yeah, you know he is a construction project major and he just got his Postgraduate Diploma, now he is looking for some similar project like yours, I wonder if you can introduce him.....Man: Well, it’s quite easy for him to join us, my colleagues and I all apply online for this voluntary work. All he needs to do is to fill in some basic information and click on the Go button to finish the application.Woman: I see, could you send me the project link later?Man: No problem. Oh, I almost forgot, he will also need a formal recommendation.All volunteers are required to have a reference to vouch for them.Woman: Okay, I will inform him of that. Thank you.
